svg.title: What a concentrated edit looks like in a diff
svg.desc: Size of the change in each of 512 rows of a last-layer matrix, against the base (log scale).
svg.text: What a concentrated edit looks like in a diff
Size of the change in each of 512 rows of a last-layer matrix, against the base (log scale).
Synthetic test checkpoints from this article’s script, not a real model
Fine-tune-style change: every row moves a little
Seven-neuron edit hidden under small noise
The edited rows changed about 575× more than the median row. Without the noise, only 7 of 512 rows change at all.
